editorial:
Imagine you are just trying to get your partner healthy after a scary car wreck, but the help you hire turns out to be your worst nightmare. You follow Brooke and Lance, a couple whose lives are turned upside down when Lance ends up stuck in bed. Enter Chloe, a nurse who looks great on paper and seems super sweet at first. She fits right into their home, but the vibe quickly shifts from helpful to creepy. You will feel the tension build as you realize that Chloe is not who she says she is and has some dark secrets from her past that are coming back to haunt her.

What really works here is how the movie keeps you guessing about Chloe's true goals. The acting is solid, and the pacing moves fast enough that you won't get bored. While some of the plot twists are a bit predictable, the thrill of the chase makes it a fun ride. If you love stories about people invading your safe space, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The big twist reveals that Chloe is actually a dangerous psychopath who targets couples. She tries to kill Brooke to take over Lance's life and money. After a scary fight in the house, Brooke manages to fight back and stop Chloe before she can finish her plan. The movie ends with the couple safe, but they are left scarred by the experience of letting a total stranger into their home.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and stories about dangerous strangers.
